title: AB 325 Cartwright Act: violations (Bus. & Prof. Code 16729)
requirement: Makes it unlawful to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination or conspiracy to restrain trade, or to use or distribute one while coercing another person to adopt its recommended price or commercial term. A common pricing algorithm is any methodology used by two or more persons that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set or influence a price or commercial term.
key_value: Criminal fines up to the greater of $6 million or twice the gain or loss for corporations; $1 million or twice the gain or loss for individuals; civil fines up to $1 million
penalty: Violations of the Cartwright Act are punishable as a crime; the digest says the bill creates a state-mandated local program because it expands the scope of prohibited activities.

status_basis: Approved by Governor October 06, 2025; Chaptered, Chapter 338. [effective_date 2026-01-01 from D028]
